400.description: The request was unacceptable, often due to missing a required parameter.

type.description: A URI reference that identifies the problem type.

title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the problem type. It remains consistent across occurrences of the same error type.

status.description: The HTTP status code generated by the origin server for this occurrence of the problem.

detail.description: A human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem.

code.description: For some errors that could be handled programmatically, a short string indicating the error code reported.

parameter.description: If the error is parameter-specific, the parameter related to the error. For example, you can use this to display a message near the correct form field.

value.title: One or more validation errors occurred.
value.detail: You should provide a well formatted CustomerId.

ResourceMissing.description:
Returned when a specified resource could not be found within the application domain, despite the request being syntactically correct.
Unlike a `404 NOT FOUND`, this error indicates that the endpoint exists, but the referenced entity (e.g., CustomerId, OrderId) does not exist in the system.
